claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_trigger (class feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Perfect Focus fires automatically on a game event (Initiative roll) with no player activation choice. The only existing class feature family is 'activation', which models player-chosen abilities. A new family is needed for passive, event-triggered effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll Initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain expended Focus Points...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: initiative_window (new RestResetCadence kind or new trigger type)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger is rolling Initiative — a specific combat-start event with no existing representation in RestResetCadence (short_rest, long_rest, short_or_long_rest, partial_short_full_long) or ClassFeatureActivationCost.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: refill_resource_to_minimum (new ClassFeatureEffect kind)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is 'regain Focus Points until you have 4' — a partial refill of a named shared resource pool to a minimum threshold. This is not heal_hp (no HP involved) and not grant_extra_action. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers cross-resource refill semantics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you regain expended Focus Points until you have 4 if you have 3 or fewer

claude_proposed_widenings.name: resource_below_threshold (conditional gate)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect only applies if the caster's current Focus Points count is at or below a specific threshold (3). This 'if you have N or fewer' conditional is not modeled anywhere in the current surface types.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: conditional_on_feature_not_used (negative feature interlock)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is suppressed if the monk also used Uncanny Metabolism on the same Initiative roll. This mutual exclusion interlock between two features has no surface representation.
